question: At matched current rack coolant and power, can current CDU primary return, coolant slope, or primary flow account for variation in the paired response?
scope: Final small state-identification sweep; no history, scheduling, or Task 1.5 acceptance experiment

preconditioning_switch_rules.high: All racks at baseline until start_s, then pulse power until rack 1 coolant first reaches at least 32.1 C; return all racks to 10.86 kW.
preconditioning_switch_rules.low: All racks at baseline until start_s, then pulse power until rack 1 coolant first reaches at most 32.1 C; return all racks to 10.86 kW.
preconditioning_switch_rules.match: After at least one complete 20 s baseline interval and t>=600 s, identify the first sample within 32.0 +/-0.1 C. Among that sample and eligible samples in the next 200 s, choose the closest to 32.0 C, breaking ties by earliest time. Publish all candidate traces and failures.

state_selection: If at least six candidates match, always include the feasible minimum-return and maximum-return states. Of remaining six-state subsets containing both, select the subset with largest log determinant of X'X for intercept plus standardized CDU return, one-tick rack-1 coolant slope, and primary flow; break ties by profile-name order. If exactly five candidates match, use all five. If fewer than five match, stop without step branches. Report predictor correlations, rank, and condition number; if near-collinear, do not claim attribution.

branch_protocol.effect: step branch minus a no-step branch restored from the same saved FMU state

primary_response_metrics.final_paired_increment_c: rack 1 step minus control at 3600 s
primary_response_metrics.peak_paired_increment_c: maximum rack 1 step minus control over 0-3600 s
primary_response_metrics.peak_to_peak_scalar_residual_c: observed paired peak increment minus the frozen coolant-only scalar prediction of peak increment
primary_response_metrics.curve_residual_at_observed_peak_time_c: observed paired response at its own peak time minus the frozen coolant-only predicted curve at that same time
primary_response_metrics.curve_errors: time-integrated mean absolute and maximum absolute observed-minus-frozen-curve residual

secondary_metrics: absolute step-branch rack 1 peak and time
time of paired window maximum, marked horizon-censored at 3600 s
all 44 coolant and CDU primary supply/return raw and paired trajectories
neighbor rack paired response and CDU primary supply/return extrema
initial all-rack power, FMU heat inputs, CDU supply/return, coolant slope, primary flow

regression.method: Leave-one-profile-out ridge regression with alpha 1.0, training-fold standardization, unpenalized intercept, no feature or hyperparameter selection; report signed residual for every profile and model for final and peak paired increments.
regression.comparison: Also publish untouched frozen eight-state coolant-only predictions and residuals. No fitted model is deployed or called sufficient from this sample alone.
regression.inference_limit: Five or six deterministic profiles are not independent plant replicates. Even with reduced collinearity, regression associations are not causal attribution, coefficient significance, or proof of observation sufficiency. No p-values or outcome-selected threshold.

stop_gate: Stop after reporting full evidence and limitations; no history matching, Task 1.5 revision, Task 1.6, scheduler, or RL work.
